routeAdjustment: The complex separation proof already uses only actual rational residues and incomparable rank-one valuation rings. Extend those same proofs to all closed original coefficient fields, then reuse the native generic finite-place indicator and prescribed-order theorem. Existing principal degree zero and the actual quotient torsion criterion supply the classes and function multiples. No new general valuation approximation theory is built.
discharged: Every pair of actual original Picard n-torsion classes, for nonzero n over every algebraically closed rational-algebra coefficient field, has disjoint original divisor/function representatives. Moving uses actual principal divisors and preserves the class; their normalized orders give the principal multiples. No moving, approximation, degree-zero or representative-existence premise remains. Pairing choice independence, descent, nondegeneracy, Hecke adjointness, determinant, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
